note: Wall time the lock-probe step's PR body read (pr_body_read, the harness-PR probe) may take before it is cut (BH-7322), capped by the worker time left before MC_WORKER_DEADLINE_AT minus 15 s. A cut read, or one not sent because under 1 s was left, writes one LOCK_PROBE_TIMEOUT line with the key and the elapsed seconds and is treated as locked (fan-in skipped:locked, a probe-timeout note on a READY row); no alert, no Sentry event. The next tick probes it again. Not a number reads as 20. Settings row: lane.merge-conductor.mc_pr_probe_read_timeout_s.
